in_hebrew.name: Hertzfeld
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Protector of the heart
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hertzfeld הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the German roots 'herz' meaning heart and 'feld' meaning field or protector. This name is of German origin and is traditionally given to a boy.

in_greek.name: Hertzfeld
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Protector of the heart
in_greek.long_meaning: Hertzfeld είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the German roots 'herz' meaning heart and 'feld' meaning field or protector. This name is of German origin and is traditionally given to a boy.

in_latin.name: Hertzfeld
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Protector of the heart
in_latin.long_meaning: Hertzfeld est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. From the German roots 'herz' meaning heart and 'feld' meaning field or protector. This name is of German origin and is traditionally given to a boy.
